label: Healing items use Hearts instead of MP
summary: HasEnoughMp treats a cost with bit 0x8000 set as a heart cost, so Potion, High Potion, X-Potion and Meal Ticket spend hearts.

edits.why: HasEnoughMp (0x800FE8B4): t0 = (cost & 0x8000) >> 12; pointer = &g_Status.mp - t0 (hearts at 0x80097BA8 when flagged); compare and subtract cost & 0x7FFF. Unflagged costs behave as vanilla.

vanilla.reason: HasEnoughMp is rewritten in place and uses only $t0 as scratch; vanilla has the same function at the same address.

overlaps.detail: The four item cost fields belong to MP Cost Items; their hearts form is written through its "with" variant.
The L2 shortcut check/subtract switches to hearts through Quick Items "with" variants.

notes: Taken from the user ASS 2.0 BIN 1aea50a7 (Resource Swap applied 10-01, differs from ASS_2.0_Resource_Swap_Addon.ppf, which hooked elsewhere). Item descriptions ("Costs 300 Hearts") are Stats-tab text and not toggled.
